title: Relative boundary cell structure of an arbitrary simplicial monomorphism
statement: Use small simplicial sets and standard simplices of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and let $\partial\Delta^n$ be the union of all proper faces of $\Delta^n$ (so $\partial\Delta^0=\varnothing$). For any degreewise injective simplicial map $i:X\hookrightarrow Y$, there is a sequence $Z_0\hookrightarrow Z_1\hookrightarrow\cdots$ of simplicial subsets of $Y$, with $Z_0$ identified with $X$ by $i$ and colimit $Y$, such that $Z_n\hookrightarrow Z_{n+1}$ is a pushout of a coproduct of copies of $\partial\Delta^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$. The copies at stage $n$ are indexed by all nondegenerate $n$-simplices (simplices not in the image of a degeneracy map) of $Y$ outside the image of $X$.
